messages:
ashley: quick sync: longprefill artifacts for zephyr-70b-int3 show small output drift after large prefill (>50k). brief dump below.

lin: what symptom? token-level mismatch or semantics?

ashley: token mismatch. e.g. expected 'presented' vs observed 'present'. cos-sim drop layer 22 ~0.95->0.86.

marco: any pattern w/ kv-shard compression or quant width?

ashley: only when kv-compress ON and quant < int8. float16 or compress off = no drift.

qa: paste bench cmd and kv meta pls

ashley: `python tools/longctx_runner.py --model zephyr-70b-int3 --prefill 52000 --kv-compress on --seed 7 --dump-kvmeta 1`
KV_META excerpt:
shards=6, shard_size=8192
prefill_len=52000
shard_offsets: [0,8192,16384,24576,32768,40960]
last_shard_write_pos: 11039  <-- >8192
phase_accum_next: 32768  <-- suspicious

lin: last_shard_write_pos > shard_size implies write_pos stored in uint16 -> overflow. phase_accum_next hitting 32768 suggests 16-bit signed saturation.

marco: quant compress path still uses legacy C kernels with uint16 counters. float path uses new backend with 64-bit.

ashley: local edit replacing uint16_t->uint32_t in compress_shard fixed symptom in smoke runs.

qa: mitigation options? gate compress when prefill>32768 or enable safe-mode using 32-bit counters.

marco: added runtime guard: if prefill_len>32768 then kv_compress_safe_mode=true. smoke: 500 runs, zero divergences, latency +4%.

lin: still file kernel fix + unit tests: write increasing token counts across shards asserting read_back_pos==expected. CI matrix: prefill 10k/40k/80k.

ashley: created ENGML-9199. PR will swap uint16->uint32 and add sanitizer. added telemetry `kv_compress_wrap_count` and `phase_accum_saturation`.

devops-bot: [deploy] canary runtime patched: roll-2026-03-23-319. Artifacts linked to ENGML-9199.

marco: next steps: land kernel PR, run cross-quant sweep (int3/int4/int8/float16) x prefill [20k,50k,100k], collect tok-mismatch rate, layer cos-sim, kv-checksum diffs. monitor telemetry for 72h.

qa: queuing experiments and will upload results to the issue.

ashley: added deterministic e2e prompt to bench/replicates/engml/zephyr-longtrans/ for SRE. will update runbook in the issue.
